**This repository has moved** to https://gitlab.wfl.fyi/wfl/wfl.

Please file this issue on GitLab instead: https://gitlab.wfl.fyi/wfl/wfl/-/issues/new

You need an account on gitlab.wfl.fyi; self-service sign-up is currently turned off, so email **info@logbie.com** to request one.

If this is a security vulnerability, do **not** file a public issue. Follow [SECURITY.md](../../SECURITY.md): open a [confidential GitLab issue](https://gitlab.wfl.fyi/wfl/wfl/-/issues/new?issue[confidential]=true), or email **info@logbie.com** with subject `WFL Security Vulnerability`.
